I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included.

The only place I found this recorded was the claude-mem prompt history, not the repo files or docs. It has two entries on the topic. The earlier one said verification was disabled in dev builds, and a later one replaced it with "verification on all builds". I used the later entry and left the earlier one out of the file, as you asked. Two prompts after that, "plain http for internal hosts" and then "https everywhere, no exceptions", don't conflict with it, so I didn't add them.

The file is not committed. If you'd rather have the policy backed by a document in the repo than by memory entries, say so and I'll adjust it.
